learning_outcomes.text: Can understand and respond appropriately to basic conversations related to daily life, education, and social contexts.
Can communicate orally about daily needs, experiences, plans, and preferences.
Can understand the main ideas of short texts, dialogues, and instructions.
Can produce basic written texts in daily life and academic contexts.
Can use core language structures such as comparisons, present perfect, quantity expressions, and adjective forms accurately.
Can identify main ideas and specific details in listening tasks.
Can perform communicative tasks through English interaction in pair and group work.
Develops confidence in using English for basic communication in daily, academic, and professional settings.

syllabus_topics: Personality - Simple present vs. present continuous
Math, history, and art - Adjectives ending in -ing and -ed
Favors and requests - Requests with would you mind, can, could and would
Before you travel - Have to and have got to for obligation
bibliography: Smart Choice 2 Workbook (4th Edition), Oxford University Press. Smart Choice Online Practice Platform / Oxford English Hub.
